info.name: Railway_Cutr
info.description: Postman collection for /api/cutr/llmRouter and /api/cutr/customPrompt, including attachment examples for OpenAI.

request.description: Routes a standard JSON request to the OpenAI provider.
OpenAI request with inline JSON attachment data. Supported attachment types: JSON, markdown, text, XML, PDF.
Multipart request with payload JSON plus a file upload. Change the file path before sending.
Routes a standard JSON request to Groq. Attachments are not supported for Groq on this endpoint.
Routes a standard JSON request to DeepSeek. Attachments are not supported for DeepSeek on this endpoint.
Browser preflight request for CUTR llmRouter.
Custom prompt request with multipart/form-data. Requires promptId, promptVersion, payload (JSON), optional file. Fixed to OpenAI provider.
Browser preflight request for CUTR customPrompt.
